briefdescription.para: Sets Baud Rate Prescaler value in Arbitration Phase.

detaileddescription.para: The system clock for the CAN controller is divided by (Prescaler + 1) to generate the quantum clock needed for sampling and synchronization. Read the device specification for details.
Baud Rate Prescaler can be set only after CAN device enters Configuration Mode. Call XCanFd_EnterMode() to enter Configuration Mode before using this function.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XCanFd instance to be worked on.
Value to set. Valid values are from 0 to 255.

simplesect.para:
- XST_SUCCESS if the Baud Rate Prescaler value is set successfully.
XST_FAILURE if CAN device is not in Configuration Mode.
